sites.name: Cadence corporate headquarters
sites.description: Cadence owns the land and buildings at its San Jose headquarters; it also owns properties in New Mexico, India, Greece and Italy.

source.label: Cadence Design Systems Form 10-K for fiscal year 2024
source.quote: We own land and buildings at our corporate headquarters located in San Jose, California. We also own properties in New Mexico, India, Greece and Italy.

notes: The FY2024 10-K gives about 12,700 employees and says 'a substantial majority of our employees are located outside of the United States', with no figures by country or region; Item 2 names owned properties (San Jose HQ; New Mexico, India, Greece, Italy) without counts per location. Cadence's ESG/impact report pages on cadence.com could not be fetched (bot protection returns 403/challenge), so no employee-by-region data was recorded. No state, country, region or tax-by-country rows.
